title: Ericsson selected for UK's Tactical Communication Systems framework
summary: Ericsson chosen as a provider for the UK Government’s Tactical Communication Systems framework (RM6393) in Lot 1 (Services) and Lot 3 (Components) The UK Ministry of Defence and wider government will have direct access to Ericsson’s full portfolio, including 5G for advanced mission-critical applications Supports the UK's strategy to modernise its defence communications, ensuring forces can achieve decision superiority in complex, multi-domain operational environments
body_markdown:
- Ericsson chosen as a provider for the UK Government’s Tactical Communication Systems framework (RM6393) in Lot 1 (Services) and Lot 3 (Components)
- The UK Ministry of Defence and wider government will have direct access to Ericsson’s full portfolio, including 5G for advanced mission-critical applications
- Supports the UK's strategy to modernise its defence communications, ensuring forces can achieve decision superiority in complex, multi-domain operational environments
